name: Miren Soursop-Mint
description: Vantara's entry into the soursop market is clean and aggressively refreshing — synth-soursop with a sharp spearmint cut and high carbonation. It's positioned as a sports-adjacent refresher without the performance-drink branding.
flavor_profile: Bright, almost sour tropical creaminess balanced by cool mint; high fizz, light body, slightly tart finish
cultural_context: Common in Shelf gyms and public rec centers — places where people work hard and want something that feels clean without paying premium prices. Vantara bundles it with their budget protein line, so it shows up everywhere synth-protein is sold.
story_hooks: Vantara has been seeding Miren Soursop-Mint into Tier 1 schools as part of a 'hydration initiative' — a player character discovers the program includes passive biometric data collection through the can's smart-surface packaging.
A street fighter on the Shelf swears by Miren before every match. Someone has started sending her cases with the pull-tab seal subtly compromised.
A Vantara quality inspector has flagged a batch with an unregistered compound. She's been told to re-file the report with different findings.
